gates.name: mission-control-query-plan-reader-ruff

intent: Replace full SQLite snapshot copying with one bounded internal query-plan executor for canonical Mission Control A2A observations. Callers submit immutable SQL-plus-parameter data before open; no live sqlite connection, cursor, callable, hook, transaction control, or filesystem capability escapes. The executor pins one read transaction, incrementally materializes detached rows under transaction-wide row/byte/VM/time limits, rejects unsafe sidecars and rollback journals, postchecks file identity and zero local changes, closes, then returns results. Normal WAL reads may update exact known SHM coordination paths; clean databases use immutable mode only under exact main/absent-sidecar bracketing. Require exact active mission status and byte-bound semantic JSON before materialization.

negative_controls.command: python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_mission_control_a2a_io.py -k 'connection_capability_never_escapes or inactive_mission_refuses or utf8_bytes'
negative_controls.name: capability-status-and-byte-controls

honest_blockers: A prior diagnostic mode=rw SELECT probe created coordination sidecars and coincided with unexplained RuntimeState file-size drift; this packet performs no live cleanup, checkpoint, or reinterpretation.
An active mission row is admission state only, never executor/provider/verifier/effect liveness.
The direct pathname reader retains an lstat-to-VFS-open TOCTOU residual inside the trusted owner root; postchecks reject drift but cannot prevent pre-rejection SHM coordination effects.
This packet authorizes observation only; every stacked PR still requires external human approval before merge.
interface_mismatches: A raw sqlite connection is an authority capability, not a read result; it must never cross the reader boundary.
SQLite SHM is mutable coordination state and cannot be treated as durable evidence or held byte-identical during legitimate WAL reads.
SQLite length(text) counts characters, while evidence bounds are UTF-8 bytes.
Per-value and row-count caps do not bound aggregate result memory; one transaction-wide detached-result byte budget is required.
session_entry.rollback: Revert the packet-scoped query-plan reader commit. No task state, provider evidence, repository effect, runtime receipt, database checkpoint, or live sidecar cleanup is part of this packet.
